metadata.case_name: SUKHDEEP SINGH v. CHOW KIN HUNG AND ANOTHER

injuries.description: fractured distal tibia and fibula of his right leg
source: Mr. Singh suffered fractured distal tibia and fibula of his right leg as a result of the accident.

injuries.description: bone was taken from Mr. Singh's right knee
source: To repair the fractures, bone was taken from Mr. Singh's right knee.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the knee or lower leg

manifestations.description: some girth discrepancy in the muscle bulk between Mr. Singh's two limbs
muscle wasting in the right leg
no gross external deformity, except multiple scars on the right ankle and slightly limited ankle motion with less than 10° difference in dorsiflexion and plantarflexion between the two ankles
slightly weaker power in the right ankle
residual pain, reduced ankle joint movement and weakness
pain would still develop in his right ankle and right knee after walking for 15 minutes
after exertion such as walking or standing for a long time, his right ankle would swell
He has a large scar over the right ankle and smaller scars on the left side of his knee
can no longer run for fitness
can no longer play Kabbadi, an Indian sport which involves running, tagging and wrestling
continued pain and discomfort over the right knee area from where the bone graft had been taken

treatments_received: open reduction and internal fixation of the fibula

losses.description: Residual pain, reduced ankle joint movement and weakness affecting daily activities
Difficulty walking long distances and up and down staircases
Multiple scars on the right ankle
Smaller scars on the left side of his knee from the bone graft donor site

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Can no longer run for fitness or play Kabbadi
